title: "War of the Chess Players"
next_chapter_hook: Although Cang Yutian's figure had dissipated into the Void, his final words before death - "The true final battle will unfold in the Heavenly Realm" - hung like a sword over their heads, announcing the arrival of a greater storm. The Three Realms had just been stabilized, yet more terrifying existences were already waiting in the Heavenly Realm.

text.content: In the instant that a ten-thousand-zhang rift tore through the sky, the entire Tianqing Sect seemed crushed beneath an invisible mountain. The disciples' knees turned weak, and those with lower cultivation even fell directly to their knees. Only Chen Ji stood alone atop the ruins, his robes flapping violently in that transcognitive pressure, yet as steady as bedrock. Cang Yutian's form descended slowly from the rift, the Universe's Eye hovering above his head, with billions of stars flickering within, each flicker carrying a suffocating wave of laws and principles.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji," Cang Yutian's voice thundered like the voice of Heaven, devoid of any emotion, "You think that with a fragmentary Tianji Record, you can oppose me?" He raised his hand, and the Universe's Eye suddenly erupted with brilliant starlight, sweeping toward Chen Ji like a galaxy pouring down, "Let me show you what a true Chess Player is."

text.content: The starlight flood swallowed everything, yet it abruptly stopped three feet from Chen Ji. His eyes had transformed into two balls of burning golden flames, and the complete Tianji Record unfolded within the depths of his pupils—not a fragment, but a complete, supreme classic encompassing the past and future. A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, a smile containing absolute confidence that had calculated the entire world. "A true Chess Player?" he repeated softly, "Coincidentally, that's exactly what I was about to say to you."

dialogue.content: "You think the Universe's Eye is invincible?" Chen Ji stepped forward, his aura surging sharply, the characters of the Tianji Record coiling around his body like living things, "I've seen it—your fatal weakness." His gaze pierced through the starlight flood, staring directly at that suspended eye, "Your will has never truly fused with this universe."

text.content: Cang Yutian's pupils contracted sharply, that momentary loss of composure fully captured by Chen Ji. That was enough—his judgment was completely correct. "The Heaven's Eye, the Demonic Path Commander, the Fate Scribe," Chen Ji tapped three times on empty air, three figures appearing凭空 behind him, "You thought they were really your chess pieces?" The supreme experts of the three factions appeared simultaneously, silently forming an alliance with Chen Ji, four forces intertwining to completely encircle Cang Yutian's Universe's Eye.

choice.prompt: The three supreme experts had allied with Chen Ji, forming an absolute encirclement of Cang Yutian. At this critical moment, Chen Ji needed to choose how to unfold this ultimate confrontation between Chess Players.

choices.description: Unite the forces of all four sides, use absolute power advantage to directly overwhelm Cang Yutian, end the battle in the shortest time possible, displaying overwhelming dominant power.
choices.visible_cost: "Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate"
choices.visible_reward: Cang Yutian defeated on the spot, the Three Realms shocked"
choices.risk_hint: "Cang Yutian may have hidden trump cards"

text.content: Chen Ji spoke no more. The Tianji Record suddenly unfolded, golden light erupting skyward. "Crush?" His voice was cold as frost, "Since you want to witness what true power is—let me show you." Four forces erupted simultaneously, the Universe's Eye trembled violently, and for the first time, a waver appeared on Cang Yutian's face.

choices.text: "Break the game with wisdom, strike at weaknesses"
choices.description: Utilize the weakness information deduced through the Tianji Record, precisely strike the fatal flaw of Cang Yutian's Universe's Eye, exchange the smallest cost for the greatest result.
choices.visible_reward: Perfectly break the Universe's Eye, achieve victory without bloodshed"

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, the Tianji Record flipping rapidly, countless runes pouring out like a waterfall. "Found it." He opened his eyes abruptly, pointing a finger through the air, "The three fusion points of the Universe's Eye—Heaven's Will, Demonic Path Origin, Fate Laws—their fusion point is right there." A precise beam of light shot toward a certain point in the Void, Cang Yutian's face instantly turning deathly pale.

choices.text: "Break the rules, create a new game"
choices.description: Refuse existing game rules, use the power of the Tianji Record to directly rewrite the fate laws of the Three Realms, creating an entirely new situation Cang Yutian never imagined.
choices.visible_cost: "Heavenly Fate heavily consumed, may trigger Heaven's backlash"
choices.visible_reward: Completely rewrite fate, obtain new power transcending the three major factions"

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made a decision that shocked everyone. "Rules?" He laughed, that smile carrying madness and determination. "Who told you this chess game must be played by your rules?" The Tianji Record burst open, countless runes pouring forth like a flood, beginning to erode, rewrite, and redefine the fate laws of the entire Three Realms.

Cang Yutian's pupils finally flickered with genuine fear. "You're mad!" His voice cracked. "Rewriting the laws of fate will trigger Heavenly Tribulation—you'll be completely erased—" But Chen Ji simply looked at him calmly, that composure in his gaze making Cang Yutian's heart chill. "So what?" Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet exploded like thunder. "You think someone who made it this far is afraid of death?"

At this moment, the Void trembled once more. A vague figure coalesced behind Chen Ji—Mo Xiansheng, that mysterious existence who had guarded the Tianji Record as a remnant soul. His form had become much more solid, his eyes gleaming with gratification and pride. "Well done," Mo Xiansheng's voice was ancient yet gentle. "You've finally taken this step. Remember, the true power of the Tianji Record lies not in foresight, but in—" He paused. "Rewriting fate."

dialogue.content: At this moment, the final seal of the Tianji Record shattered completely. Mo Xiansheng's form began to dissipate, but the power he left behind flowed continuously into Chen Ji. "This is Chen Tianming's final gift," Mo Xiansheng's voice faded into the distance. "He asked me to tell you—my son, you've done better than anyone could have imagined. Now, create your own destiny."

text.content: Cang Yutian felt a threat unprecedented. The Universe's Eye operated frantically, endless starlight turning into blades bombardment toward Chen Ji, yet they were blocked by the combined forces of the Heavenly Eye, the Demonic Path Commander, and the Fate Scribe. "No... impossible!" He howled, his voice carrying hysterical madness. "I am the ultimate chess player, the master of the Three Realms—" But his voice stopped abruptly before Chen Ji, because Chen Ji had already extended a finger, pressing it against the surface of the Universe's Eye.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji's finger had touched the Universe's Eye, and at that moment, he saw countless branches of fate. At this moment, he had to choose the ultimate direction of this final confrontation.

choices.description: Completely destroy the Universe's Eye, depriving Cang Yutian of all sources of power, casting him down from grace, making him taste the滋味 of falling from the clouds.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger upheaval across the Three Realms
choices.visible_reward: Cang Yutian suffers complete defeat, utterly demoralized
choices.risk_hint: The balance of the Three Realms may be disrupted

text.content: Chen Ji's finger suddenly erupted with dazzling golden light, the power of the Tianji Record surged into the Universe's Eye like a breached dam. "Destroy?" His voice was ice-cold. "No, I won't kill you." The golden light suddenly contracted, the Universe's Eye letting out a piercing wail. "I want you to live, watching your empire that you built with your own hands turn to nothing."

choices.description: Use this rare opportunity to directly rewrite the death prophecy in Chapter 700, completely erasing that destined ending, carving out a completely new future for himself and all those who were drawn into fate because of him.
choices.visible_reward: Death prophecy rewritten, Chen Ji's chains of fate completely freed
choices.risk_hint: Zero Heavenly Fate Value may cause temporary dissipation of power

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, the pages of the Tianji Record flipped wildly, finally settling on a certain page. He saw his own death, saw that inescapable endpoint of fate. "Here it is." His finger pointed at that death prophecy, golden light pouring in, the characters twisting, dissolving, reorganizing—the word "Chen Ji" was followed by the original six characters "death by Heavenly Tribulation" completely erased, replaced by a completely new ending.

choices.description: Not destruction, not rewriting, but completely breaking the existing pattern of fate, creating a completely new world that neither Cang Yutian nor even the Heavenly Eye could have envisioned.
choices.visible_reward: Become a "Game Creator" beyond the chess player

text.content: Chen Ji laughed, a completely liberated smile. "Destruction is too boring, rewriting is too conservative." He spread his arms wide, the Tianji Record burst open. "What I want is—for this entire chessboard to cease to exist." In an instant, golden light devoured everything, the laws of the Three Realms began to collapse and reshape. Cang Yutian惊恐地发现, the entire world he knew was being completely rewritten by a single thought from Chen Ji.

When the golden light faded, Cang Yutian found himself still standing in place, but everything around him had changed. His Universe's Eye still existed, but could no longer sense the laws of the Three Realms—because that Three Realms he knew no longer existed. "You..." He tried to speak, but found his voice could no longer be transmitted. "What exactly did you do?" Chen Ji stood quietly before him, his gaze as calm as still water. "I'm just telling you a truth—"

dialogue.content: "A true chess player never manipulates the rules." Chen Ji spoke word by word, each syllable striking Cang Yutian's heart like thunder. "Rather, they are those who can break the rules and create them." He turned away, no longer looking at the once invincible ultimate chess master. "You have lost. You lost because you were too immersed in the game of chess pieces, forgetting—chess pieces can also become chess players."

text.content: "The Heavenly Celestial Eye gazed down for a long while before slowly closing. It did not punish Chen Ji's actions—for in this new world, it could no longer constrain this young man with outdated rules. The Demonic Path Commander and the Fate Scribe exchanged glances, both seeing the same emotion in each other's eyes: reverence, and a trace of relief. Relief that they had not become Chen Ji's enemies."

"Cang Yutian knelt on the ground, the light of the Cosmic Eye fading completely. But just as Chen Ji thought it was over, the man suddenly threw his head back and laughed wildly. 'Hahaha! Good! Well said about breaking the rules!' His laughter carried madness, yet also a kind of release. 'Chen Ji, you've won this round. But do you think this is the end?' He slowly stood up. 'Don't forget—the true final battle lies in the Heavenly Realm.'"

dialogue.content: "Terrifying existences of the Heavenly Realm await you." Cang Yutian's form began to dissipate, but his voice echoed like a curse. "You think you defeated the ultimate chess player? No, I was merely a chess piece on a higher board." His laughter faded into the distance. "The true chess player... is in the Heavenly Realm!"

text.content: "Chen Ji stood still, watching Cang Yutian's form completely fade away. His expression held no fluctuation, as if he had long foreseen this. 'I know.' He said softly, a hint of imperceptible weariness in his voice. 'From the very beginning, I knew—the Heavenly Realm is the final battlefield of this game.' He looked up at the sky he had reshaped, his gaze deep and resolute."

"The wind stirred and clouds gathered, as the final page of the Tianji Record slowly appeared before Chen Ji. What was recorded there was no earth-shattering secret technique, but a simple passage—the last testament left by Chen Tianming before his fall: 'My son, if you can read these words, it means you have surpassed me. The road ahead, you must walk alone. The enemies of the Heavenly Realm are far more terrifying than you can imagine. But I believe, you will surely find your own answer.'"

"Chen Ji gazed at those words, a smile slowly curving his lips. That smile held release, resolve, and a trace of faint melancholy. 'Father,' he said softly, 'I will.' He turned toward the sky waiting for the storm. 'Heavenly Realm, here I come.'"

"Though Cang Yutian's form had vanished into the void, his dying words—'the true final battle will unfold in the Heavenly Realm'—hung like a sword over their heads, heralding the arrival of a greater storm. With the Three Realms newly settled, more terrifying existences already waited in the Heavenly Realm. Chen Ji had fulfilled his promise to Chen Tianming, yet discovered he was about to face enemies far more dreadful than he had imagined—those supreme beings who transcended heaven's way, transcended fate, transcended all comprehension."
